claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates have risen.
As of late March 2026, many lenders average above 6.5% for 30-year fixed mortgage rates.
As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates have hit their highest levels in over three months.
Freddie Mac reported a 6.22% average 30-year fixed mortgage rate on March 19, 2026.
As of March 23, 2026, daily surveys indicate 30-year fixed mortgage rate averages closer to 6.37%–6.5%.
30-year fixed mortgage rates fell below 6% briefly in early March 2026.
30-year fixed mortgage rates have increased after falling below 6% briefly in early March 2026.
As of late March 2026, 30-year refinance rates average around 6.74% to 6.9%.
